tests.code: let log = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new())); let (s, r) = channel(); for name in ["a", "b"] { let log = log.clone(); spawn(&s, async move { for i in 0..2 { log.lock().unwrap().push(format!("{name}{i}")); Yield { done: false }.await; } }); } drop(s); run(r); assert_eq!(*log.lock().unwrap(), ["a0", "b0", "a1", "b1"]);

let hit = Arc::new(Mutex::new(0)); let (s, r) = channel(); for _ in 0..50 { let hit = hit.clone(); spawn(&s, async move { Yield { done: false }.await; *hit.lock().unwrap() += 1; }); } drop(s); run(r); assert_eq!(*hit.lock().unwrap(), 50);
